ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A square $ ABCD$ with sides of length 1 is divided into two congruent trapezoids and a pentagon, which have equal areas, by joining the center of the square with points $ E,F,G$ where $ E$ is the midpoint of $ BC$, $ F,G$ are on $ AB$ and $ CD$, respectively, and they're positioned that $ AF < FB, DG < GC$ and $ F$ is the directly opposite of $ G$. If $ FB = x$, the length of the longer parallel side of each trapezoid, find the value of $ x$.

Then reason: The side length of the square is 1, so the total area is 1. The figure is divided into two congruent trapezoids and one pentagon, and the three parts have equal areas, so the area of each part is 1/3. Take the upper trapezoid FBEO; its two parallel horizontal sides are respectively FB = x and OE = 1/2, because O is the center of the square and E is the midpoint of the right side. The height between the two parallel sides is also 1/2. By the trapezoid area formula, the area is ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2). Set it equal to 1/3, getting ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2) = 1/3, that is, (x + 1/2)/4 = 1/3, so x + 1/2 = 4/3, x = 4/3 - 1/2 = 5/6.

claims.source: Take the upper trapezoid FBEO

claims.claim: One parallel horizontal side of the upper trapezoid FBEO is FB.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: Its two parallel horizontal sides are respectively FB = x and OE = 1/2

claims.claim: The other parallel horizontal side of the upper trapezoid FBEO is OE.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: Its two parallel horizontal sides are respectively FB = x and OE = 1/2

claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: OE = 1/2, because O is the center of the square and E is the midpoint of the right side

claims.claim: O is the center of the square.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: O is the center of the square

claims.claim: E is the midpoint of the right side.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: E is the midpoint of the right side

claims.claim: The height between the two parallel sides is 1/2.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The height between the two parallel sides is also 1/2

claims.claim: The trapezoid area formula uses the sum of the two parallel sides divided by 2 and then multiplied by the height.
claims.label: knowledge
claims.source: By the trapezoid area formula, the area is ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2)

claims.claim: The area of the upper trapezoid FBEO is ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2).
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The area is ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2)

claims.claim: Set the area of the upper trapezoid FBEO equal to 1/3.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Set it equal to 1/3

claims.claim: Obtain the equation ((x + 1/2)/2)(1/2) = 1/3.
claims.label: reasoning

claims.claim: Solving this equation gives x = 5/6.
claims.label: reasoning
